instruction: Install LibreOffice Impress for creating presentations.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing LibreOffice Impress component. Evaluator uses dpkg -l to check if libreoffice-impress is installed (ii status means installed). Uses existing check_list metric with cache_file getter and regex pattern matching.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - uses same pattern of checking package installation status

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses dpkg -l command to check package installation status on Debian/Ubuntu systems
Regex pattern 'ii\s+libreoffice-impress' correctly matches dpkg output format where 'ii' indicates installed package
check_list metric correctly reads cache file and performs regex pattern matching
Complete coverage: instruction only requires verifying installation, evaluator checks exactly that
Correct data flow: postconfig runs dpkg command -> saves to cache file -> getter retrieves file -> metric checks pattern
Proper edge case handling: returns 0.0 if package not installed, doesn't exist, or file is missing/empty
